address: 73F, Landmark 81, Vinhomes Central Park, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: This French restaurant soars over 300m above Saigon in the Landmark 81 skyscraper. It serves a stunning range of truffles: each tasting menu features the seasonal fungi sourced from different countries. The variety of breads is also impressive, each type boasting its own unique characteristics. The large dining area is surrounded by floor-to-ceiling windows that frame exceptional views of the city – a truly breathtaking experience!...
